items.prompt: Which normal-CDF expression computes a small negative tail without explicitly subtracting a near-one CDF from 1?

options.why: The near-one subtraction can lose relative tail information.
This is the formula used for the CDF in the separate adapter.

options.text: exp(x), with no normalization or integral.
options.why: The exponential alone is not the standard normal cumulative distribution.

items.explanation: This is the formula used for the CDF in the separate adapter.
